## About Me

I'm a postdoctoral researcher at Lingnan University. My main interests are at the
intersections of value, metaphysics, and consciousness. I'm interested in questions like:

- What makes a feeling pleasant, or unpleasant?
- How can our feelings towards things make a difference to what is good for us?
- Can moral feelings make us act in certain ways?
- What sorts of feelings can non-human creatures have?

You can reach me at [danielpallies@ln.edu.hk](mailto:danielpallies@ln.edu.hk),
or find me on [Academia.edu](https://usc.academia.edu/DanielPallies) and
[PhilPeople](https://philpeople.org/profiles/daniel-pallies).
